courses.title: Ecohydrology of Watersheds and Water Systems
courses.description: Analysis of water resources from a water-in-ecosystem perspective. Application to natural, managed, and urban systems, considering ecological interactions with hydrological processes. Exploration of biogeochemical processes related to water quality, and human impacts on water resources. [3-0-0] Prerequisite: Third or fourth-year standing in Science, Applied Science, Land and Food Systems, or Forestry and Environmental Stewardship.

courses.title: Environmental Policy and Law
courses.description: The creation, implementation and enforcement of environmental laws and policies at the international, national, and sub-national levels. Examination and critique of laws, principles, and policies dealing with issues such as climate change, pollution, and biological diversity. [3-0-0] Prerequisite: 4th-year class standing.

courses.title: Student Directed Seminars in Environmental Sciences
courses.description: Self-directed, collaborative studies in environmental sciences, in a group-learning environment, initiated and coordinated by senior undergraduate students with the supervision of a faculty advisor. Course structure, enrolment, and delivery methods will comply with the Handbook for Student Directed Seminars. Prerequisite: Third-year standing. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
